evals.prompt: 帮我多源搜一下「检索增强生成在临床问答中的应用」最近几年的论文，我想知道哪些结论是各个来源都认可的、哪些还有争议。
evals.expected_output: A cited cross-source synthesis report in Chinese: 检索概况 (states which of 4 sources ran + skipped), 共识发现, 分歧高亮, 每源独有贡献, 论文排名表 with consensus column, 参考文献. Should run fanout.py with 2-3 query variants, surface degradation honestly if sources are skipped.

evals.prompt: search arxiv and openalex for recent work on parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models — I want the most-cited papers and whether the different sources agree on what the strongest methods are
evals.expected_output: English cross-source report. fanout.py invoked with English variants (LoRA / PEFT / adapter aliases). Ranking table sorted by consensus then citations. Notes which sources were live. Claim-level comparison of which methods sources agree are strongest.
